title: Bear Run Campground

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: So much to make you so comfortable... our Amenities at Bear Run Campground are thoughtful conveniences that seek to make your experience with us near Lake Arthur& Moraine State Park as relaxing and fulfilling as it can possibly be. If you need anything else for your stay, just let us know! Our General Store and gift shop is a well-stocked adventure into souvenirs, camping necessities, and everything else you might need during your vacation with us. From Bingo to parties to any reason to get together, our Recreation Center is the roof over our heads that contains the good times of time spent together on your camping vacation! Our picnic pavilion at Bear Run is the perfect place to congregate

services.name: Log Cabin
services.desc: These deluxe cabins offer a hilltop getaway with a northeastern view overlooking our campground and the outlying woodlands. These cabins offer a spacious interior with separate living and sleeping space. The bedroom offers 2 sets of bunk beds (totaling 3 single beds and a full bed). There is also a fun little carpeted sleeping loft above the bedroom. With beautiful split-timber siding and wooden accents both exterior and interior these cabins are a wonderful choice for families up to six people, small groups, or a couple who just wants a few more home-like amenities.
